p: the iniquity of the sanctuary: If you trespass in anything concerning the ceremonies of the sanctuary of your office, you will be punished.
keep thy charge: That is, the things which are committed to you, or, which you command them.
stranger shall not come nigh unto: Which was not of the tribe of Levi.
offerings of all the hallowed things: As the first fruit, first born, and the tithes.
fire: That which was not burned should be the priests.
holy place shalt thou eat it: That is, in the sanctuary between the court and the holiest of holies.
best of the oil: Or, fat; chiefest.
redeem: Because they are appointed for sacrifice.
of salt for ever before the: That is, sure, stable and incorruptible.
come nigh the tabernacle of the: To serve in it: for the Levites are put in their place.
their iniquity: If they fail in their office, they will be punished.
corn of the threshingfloor: As acceptable as the fruit of your own ground or vineyard.
gifts ye shall offer every heave: Which you have received from the children of Israel.
You shall not be punished therefore.
things of the children of Israel: The offerings which the Israelites have offered to God.
